title: Tier Change Terms by Linden Membership Tier
content:
Each tier of Linden Memberships states when an upgrade takes effect, whether an immediate upgrade is charged the prorated difference for the rest of the current month, when a downgrade takes effect, and the minimum number of calendar months between two tier changes.

## Terms

| Tier | Upgrade takes effect | Immediate upgrade charged the prorated difference for the rest of the month | Downgrade takes effect | Minimum months between two tier changes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Linden Connect Virtual Membership | Immediately | Yes | At the next period | 3 |
| Linden Essential Membership | Immediately | Yes | At the next period | 3 |
| Linden Family Membership | Immediately | Yes | At the next period | 6 |
| Linden Plus Membership | Immediately | Yes | At the next period | 3 |
| Linden Premier Concierge Membership | Immediately | Yes | At the next period | 6 |
| Linden Executive Health Membership | At the next period | No | At the next period | 12 |

## Reading the terms

- The upgrade timing is read from the tier being moved to. An upgrade into any tier other than the Linden Executive Health Membership takes effect immediately and is charged the prorated difference for the rest of the current month; an upgrade into the Linden Executive Health Membership takes effect at the next period and carries no such proration charge.
- A downgrade takes effect at the next period on every tier.
- The minimum interval between two tier changes is 3 months on the Linden Connect Virtual Membership, Linden Essential Membership and Linden Plus Membership, 6 months on the Linden Family Membership and Linden Premier Concierge Membership, and 12 months on the Linden Executive Health Membership.
